mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy, which reduces the discount rate for equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE has risen above 4.5% in 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the core inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signal a tightening monetary policy amid persistent inflation, which compresses equity valuations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS both exceed their 90th percentile in the prior month, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime characterized by high housing starts (HOUST), a decline in housing starts signals weakening demand for residential construction, which reduces economic growth expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during late-cycle expansion when HOUST declines, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over the past two months signals strong consumer demand, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where RSAFS has increased over the prior two months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 in a 3-month window, it signals a contraction in manufacturing output, which reduces corporate profits and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO has fallen below 100 in 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signal a broad-based economic slowdown, which reduces corporate earnings growth expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and INDPRO decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a federal funds rate above 4.5% signals aggressive policy to curb inflation, which increases the cost of capital and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during monetary tightening cycles when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
